info.title: FreeITSM REST API
info.description:
The FreeITSM REST API. Every request is authenticated with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer fitsm_...`); keys start with zero permissions and are granted granular per-resource, per-action rights, optionally scoped to specific companies.

Success responses are `{ "data": ... }`, with a `meta` block on paginated lists. Errors are `{ "error": { "code": ..., "message": ... } }` with a real HTTP status. Timestamps are UTC ISO 8601, except the calendar module, which uses naive server-local datetimes (noted on those operations). Writes behave exactly like the web UI — audit rows, workflow events, emails and SLA all fire.

The default rate limit is 60 requests/minute per key; every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

post.description: Creates an asset record. hostname is the identity the inventory agent and Intune sync upsert on, so a duplicate hostname is refused (409) — PATCH the existing asset instead. All other fields are optional and match PATCH below. The optional fields object accepts values keyed by applicable custom field_key. Omitted keys remain unchanged; null or an empty string clears a non-required value. An empty object is a no-op. Unknown/inapplicable keys or invalid values return 422. Core and custom changes are atomic. Top-level keys the write does not use are still accepted, but the response names them in an ignored array (absent when there are none) instead of answering as if they were saved.

post.description: Links this asset to a configuration item in the same company: "these two records are the same piece of equipment". An identity, not a dependency - nothing is added to the CMDB graph and nothing is copied. Safe to retry: the same pair again answers 200 with unchanged true. One live link per asset and per CI: if either already has one, the answer is 409 ci_already_linked or asset_already_linked, naming the other record (or saying it is one the key cannot see), with the live link ids in error.details.conflicts. To replace on purpose, send replace true and replaces_link_ids with exactly those ids; if the links changed since, the answer is 409 link_changed, so a newer link is never displaced silently. Needs only this permission - not assets.update or cmdb_objects.update - and the key's company scope must reach both records. POST rather than PUT because this API takes only GET, POST, PATCH and DELETE.

post.description: Reports what an external tool (an RMM, Lansweeper, a CMDB export) saw on this asset: software, volumes (disks) and network adapters. The rows go into the same inventory every screen and report reads, tagged with your source, and no other source's rows are touched. The asset's own fields and last_seen ("the agent reported") never change. A source name belongs to one analyst per company - the first to write it - so a rotated key for the same analyst keeps it; built-in names (agent, intune, ...) are refused. (source, source_device_ref) links to one asset; naming it on another is a 409 naming the asset. Each section is judged on its own: complete = exactly this list for this source (an empty list removes all of them), partial = added and updated only, omitted = untouched; older than the newest applied = stale, same time and content = replayed, same time and different content = failed (observation_conflict). A section that fails is rolled back alone, named, and recorded as failed beside its last good data (GET .../inventory); the others apply (207). Send the same report again to retry the failed sections - the applied ones answer replayed. Each applied section reports added, updated and removed counts. A connections section (the assets physically connected to this one) also lists, as unmatched, any serial no asset has or several share - kept for review in Assets, never created.

Each section applies in its own savepoint: 207 when some failed (send the same report again to retry them), 422 when all did. A VM or host that comes back with a new identity while one of the same name stops being seen is raised for review in Assets -> Settings -> Hyper-V, never merged automatically.

InventoryConnectionItem.description: Exactly one of connected_asset_id or serial.

connected_asset_id.description: The other asset's FreeITSM id, if your tool has already matched it. Must be in this asset's company.

serial.description: The other device's serial (a monitor's EDID serial), matched like any inventory source - never guessed between two assets.

connected.description: false = your tool saw it is no longer connected; ends your row for it.

source.description: manual (confirmed by a person) or rest:<your source>

reported_here.description: true if recorded from this asset's side

last_observed_at.description: When the source last saw it connected - not a current assignment

current.description: Connected now, one entry per other asset, each source's row beside the others

history.description: Connections that have ended, newest first

source.description: Your tool's name. Owned by the first analyst to write it in the company; built-in names (agent, intune, proxmox, vcloud, vcenter, manual, api, system, freeitsm) are refused.

source_device_ref.description: Your tool's own id for the device; linked to one asset per company.

observed_at.description: Original observation: RFC3339 seconds and explicit timezone, at most five minutes in future.

connections.description: Assets physically connected to this one (a monitor, a dock). Complete = these and no others: a connection of yours not listed ends. Partial never ends one. A serial no asset has (or several do) is kept for review, never created.

sections.description: One entry per section sent, keyed software / disks / network_adapters.

source_device_ref.description: Null for the inventory agent (source agent)

observed_at.description: When the last good data was observed; null if the section has only ever failed

company.description: The company that owns this asset. null = not assigned to one.

retired_at.description: When the asset moved into a status ticked Retired - it has left the estate. Null when it has not.

fields.description: Custom field values, keyed by field key. Absent keys mean the field is not recorded on this asset.

linked_ci.description: GH #201: the configuration item this asset is linked to; {restricted: true} without cmdb_objects.read; null when not linked.

path.description: Full breadcrumb path, e.g. "UK › London › Office 1".

source.description: null = manual; a generator name (e.g. "asset_warranty") = generated and read-only.

CalendarEventCategory.description: The event's calendar category (null if uncategorised).

CalendarEventCreatedBy.description: The analyst who created the event (null for the generated-event 0 sentinel).

Change.description: A change record (Change Management). Returned by list/create/update; GET by id returns the richer ChangeDetail.

level.description: The result in its policy's words; the built-in policy's are Low, Medium, High, Very High, Critical.

policy.description: The risk policy the ratings were given under; null when unrated.

ChangeAuditEntry.description: A per-field audit row on a change (action_type is status_change, field_change, cab_vote or comment).

ChangeCab.description: The CAB roster for a change, returned by GET /changes/{id}/cab and POST /changes/{id}/cab (which replaces the roster then returns this same shape).

ChangeCabVoteResult.description: Returned by POST /changes/{id}/cab/vote. new_status is set only when the vote decided the round - the name of the status it moved to (a Draft-stage status on a required Reject, the first Approved-stage status once the threshold is met). counted is false for a vote by one of the change's own people in Enforce mode; was_current is false for a vote cast against an earlier version (null = not stated).

ChangeApproval.description: The current approval round of a change (#180), and current_version - the fingerprint of its material content that a vote or decision sends back as content_hash. id is null when the change has no current round.

changed_fields.description: Long field => the revision id the round was given, for the fields that changed since.

ChangeApprovalRound.description: One approval round of a change (#180).

snapshot.description: material (the field keys), values (short fields by value, long by sha256), revisions (long field => revision id), template_version_id.

ChangeRevision.description: One saved version of a long-text field (#180), without its content.

ChangeRevisionDetail.description: One saved version of a long-text field (#180), with its full content and the id of the version before it.

ChangeCategoryRef.description: The change category — a lookup row (id set) or a legacy free-text value (id null, pre-lookup installs). Null when neither is set.

ChangeDetail.description: The full change detail returned by GET /changes/{id}: every Change field plus bodies, PIR, attachments and linked problems, and the current approval round.

risk.description: Includes evaluation, which is only present on the detail view.

level.description: The result in its policy's words; the built-in policy's are Low, Medium, High, Very High, Critical.

policy.description: The risk policy the ratings were given under; null when unrated.

ChangeLinkedProblem.description: A problem this change fixes (read from change_relations).

CmdbClass.description: A CI class as listed by GET /cmdb/classes (no property definitions — see GET /cmdb/classes/{id}).

icon.description: Icon key from GET /cmdb-icons, or null if the class has none set.

object_count.description: Number of CMDB objects currently using this class.

CmdbClassDetail.description: A CI class with its full typed property schema (GET /cmdb/classes/{id}).

CmdbClassProperty.description: A typed property definition on a CI class.

options.description: Dropdown options; empty for every property type other than dropdown.

CmdbClassPropertyOption.description: One dropdown option for a property whose type is dropdown.

colour.description: Hex colour (e.g. "#22c55e"), or null for the plain-text fallback.

CmdbClassPropertyTargetClass.description: Only present when the property's type is object_ref; the class the reference must point at.

CmdbImpact.description: Blast radius for GET /cmdb/objects/{id}/impact: descendants, property references, and incoming relationships.

depth.description: Hops below the root object (1 = direct child).

CmdbImpactPropertyRef.description: An object that references the queried object via one of its own object_ref properties.

CmdbImpactRelationshipRef.description: An object with an incoming relationship pointing at the queried object (i.e. something that depends on it).

relationship.description: The inverse verb read from the dependent object's side (e.g. "is depended on by").

CmdbLinkedTicket.description: A ticket linked to a CMDB object, scoped to the API key's companies.

CmdbObject.description: A CMDB object (CI) as returned by list/create/update. See CmdbObjectDetail for the fully hydrated GET-by-id shape.

company.description: The company this configuration item belongs to. null = the Default company. A CI belongs to exactly one company: its parent, its relationships and any object_ref properties must all stay within it.

CmdbObjectClassRef.description: The object's class, embedded on every object representation. Class is immutable after object creation.

CmdbObjectDeleteResult.description: Acknowledgement for DELETE /cmdb/objects/{id}. The whole descendant subtree was removed too.

deleted_descendants.description: Count of descendant objects deleted along with this one.

CmdbObjectDetail.description: A fully hydrated CMDB object (GET /cmdb/objects/{id}): every class property with its typed value, parent, children, relationships in both directions, and the cached AI summary. Neighbours (parent, children, object_ref targets, relationship counterparties) are themselves company-scoped, so one outside the key's companies is omitted rather than named.

company.description: The company this configuration item belongs to. null = the Default company.

ai_summary.description: Cached AI-generated summary of this CI, or null if none has been generated yet.

linked_asset.description: GH #201: the asset this configuration item is linked to; {restricted: true} without assets.read; null when not linked.

CmdbObjectPropertyValue.description: One typed property value on a hydrated object.

value.description: Polymorphic value, typed per the property definition (string, number, boolean, date or an object reference); null when unset.

value_object.description: Only populated when type is object_ref and a value is set — the referenced object's id/name/class_name.

CmdbObjectRef.description: A lightweight reference to another CMDB object (parent, child, or an object_ref property's target).

CmdbRelationshipEntry.description: One relationship edge from an object's point of view, in either the outgoing or incoming direction.

id.description: The relationship row id (usable with DELETE .../relationships/{rel_id}).

verb.description: The forward verb (e.g. "depends on"), regardless of which direction this entry is.

ColouredLookupItem.description: A coloured lookup item with a default flag, shared by change types/priorities/impacts, task priorities and problem priorities.

customer.description: Set when party_type is customer: the company, the person, or both.

ContractTerm.description: One term tab with this contract's recorded content for it.

content.description: Null where nothing has been recorded for this tab yet.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 code such as GBP, EUR or IDR. Any currency in use is accepted; anything else is refused.

Domain.description: A domain in the register. Auth codes are never returned - see auth_code_set.

scope.description: public, or internal: never sent outside the network, and given a health instead of a grade (GH #203)

health.description: An internal domain's health; null for a public domain. state is worked out when read: stale when no check has completed for twice the interval. known is the last completed result, kept when later checks cannot complete.

customer.description: The person the domain is looked after for (#153): a user in the domain's own company.

tech_analyst.description: The technical contact when it is one of your analysts (#162). At most one of tech_contact and tech_analyst is set.

customer_supplier.description: The customer when it is a supplier (#162). Never set together with customer.

customer_contact.description: The supplier contact the domain is for (#162), usually alongside customer_supplier.

auth_code_set.description: Whether an auth code is stored. The code itself is never returned by the API.

DomainWithChanges.description: A domain after a registry lookup, with what the lookup changed.

customer_contact.description: The supplier contact the domain is for (#162), usually alongside customer_supplier.

auth_code_set.description: Whether an auth code is stored. The code itself is never returned by the API.

DomainCheckResult.description: A domain after its checks ran: the findings, and what change detection saw move.

scope.description: public, or internal: never sent outside the network, and given a health instead of a grade (GH #203)

health.description: An internal domain's health; null for a public domain. state is worked out when read: stale when no check has completed for twice the interval. known is the last completed result, kept when later checks cannot complete.

customer.description: The person the domain is looked after for (#153): a user in the domain's own company.

tech_analyst.description: The technical contact when it is one of your analysts (#162). At most one of tech_contact and tech_analyst is set.

customer_supplier.description: The customer when it is a supplier (#162). Never set together with customer.

customer_contact.description: The supplier contact the domain is for (#162), usually alongside customer_supplier.

auth_code_set.description: Whether an auth code is stored. The code itself is never returned by the API.

params.description: The values the title and advice were filled from.

http_path.description: The page asked for once the certificate passes; null = no HTTP check

status.description: The last completed result; null when never checked

not_checked_since.description: The latest attempt could not run; status is the last known result

detail.description: Why: healthy, expiring, expired, wrong_name, untrusted, no_answer, no_address, http_status, http_no_answer, network_refused, port_refused ...

certificate.description: subject, issuer, valid_from, valid_to, days_left, sans, hostname_match, chain_valid

expected_values.description: Empty when the record type only has to exist

summary.description: Each CA's name and expiry - never the certificates

id.description: The id from the path. The router casts every path segment to an integer before the handler runs, so it is a number.

Form.description: A form with its full field definitions — returned by get/create/update/version-create.

versions_deleted.description: Count of version rows removed — 1 unless ?chain=true wiped the whole chain.

field_type.description: One of: text, textarea, email, number, checkbox, checkboxes, dropdown, radio.

options.description: Array of choice labels for dropdown / radio / checkboxes fields; null for other field types (loosely typed — falls back to the raw stored string if it is not valid JSON).

value.description: Polymorphic value, typed per the field or property definition.

FormSummary.description: A form without its field definitions — used by list endpoints (GET /forms, GET /forms/{id}/versions).

is_current.description: True when this row is the chain leaf (editable); false for frozen historical versions.

IdNameRef.description: Common lookup shape: {id, name}. Null when the ticket has no value set for this field.

KnowledgeArticle.description: The full article as returned by get/create/update/restore — full HTML body instead of a preview.

company.description: The company that owns this article. null = shared with every company.

audience.description: Who may read the article. internal = analysts only; customer = also signed-in self-service users; public = also anonymous web chat visitors.

body_html.description: Raw TinyMCE HTML, stored and returned verbatim.

has_embedding.description: Whether a search embedding has been generated (requires the module's OpenAI key to be configured).

archived_at.description: Only present when is_archived is true.

archived_by.description: Only present when is_archived is true.

KnowledgeArticleArchiveAck.description: Acknowledgement for moving an article to the recycle bin.

KnowledgeArticlePurgeAck.description: Acknowledgement for permanently deleting an archived article.

KnowledgeArticleSummary.description: A knowledge article as returned by the list/search endpoint — a preview instead of the full body.

company.description: The company that owns this article. null = shared with every company.

audience.description: Who may read the article. internal = analysts only; customer = also signed-in self-service users; public = also anonymous web chat visitors.

preview.description: Plain-text excerpt of the body, tags stripped, truncated to 300 characters.

archived_at.description: Only present when is_archived is true.

archived_by.description: Only present when is_archived is true.

KnowledgeArticleVersion.description: A version-history entry as returned by the list endpoint (no body).

KnowledgeArticleVersionDetail.description: A single version snapshot with its full HTML body.

LookupIdNameActive.description: A simple tenant-overridable lookup item (GET /ticket-types, GET /origins).

LookupRef.description: A referenced lookup row rendered as {id, name}; null when unset.

LookupWithDescription.description: A lookup item with an optional description, shared by several small reference lists (departments, asset types/statuses, change categories, contract/payment/supplier lookups).

date.description: Bare YYYY-MM-DD — defaults to server-local today.

MorningCheckBoardResult.description: Null when this check has no result recorded for the board date yet.

status.description: Null when the result has no resolvable status (see is_orphan).

is_orphan.description: True when the status this result was saved against has since been deleted.

orphan_label.description: The original status label snapshot, present only when is_orphan is true.

NamedRef.description: A lightweight id/name reference to a lookup row. Null when unset.

NetworkBrandingSlot.description: One header/footer band. Each slot is null = inherit the org-wide branding default.

NetworkDiagram.description: A fully hydrated diagram version: metadata, print/branding settings, every node and connector, and computed layout metadata.

NetworkDiagramAuthor.description: The analyst who created this diagram version (null if the creating key/analyst no longer exists).

versions_deleted.description: 1 unless ?chain=true, in which case every version in the chain.

NetworkDiagramSummary.description: A diagram version without its contents (list / version-chain rows).

parent_diagram_id.description: Null for the root version of the chain.

is_current.description: true when this version has no children — the only editable version.

width.description: 0 when the diagram has no nodes.

height.description: 0 when the diagram has no nodes.

NetworkLayoutBounds.description: The canvas bounding box in raw x/y units (top-left origin per node, expanded by each node's pixel size). Null when the diagram has no nodes.

size_px.description: Pixel footprint for this size class (small=40, medium=56, large=80).

icon.description: What actually renders: icon_override, else the class's icon, else 'box'.
The class's default icon key (null if the class has none set).

connectors_deleted.description: How many connectors touching this node were removed with it.

properties.description: Only present when the diagram was fetched with ?include_properties=true.

NetworkNodeSizesPx.description: Pixel footprint for each node size class.

NetworkObjectProperty.description: One typed CI property value (only present when a node was fetched with ?include_properties=true).

value.description: Polymorphic value, typed per the field or property definition.

NetworkPaper.description: Print layout. Both fields null = no paper overlay in the editor.

NetworkRelationshipRef.description: The CMDB relationship this connector represents, if any.

verb.description: Null if the underlying CMDB relationship was since deleted.

NetworkSuggestion.description: One CMDB neighbour of an on-diagram object that isn't drawn yet.

NetworkSuggestionVia.description: One path linking the suggested object back to something already on the diagram.

kind.description: 'relationship' = a CMDB object relationship (either direction); 'property' = an object_ref property link (either direction).

from_object_id.description: The on-diagram object this path originates from.

label.description: The relationship verb (or its inverse) or the property label.

Problem.description: A problem record (Problem Management). Returned by list/create/update; GET by id returns the richer ProblemDetail.

ProblemAuditEntry.description: A per-field audit row on a problem.

ProblemDetail.description: The full problem detail returned by GET /problems/{id}: every Problem field plus linked incidents and changes.

ProblemLinkedChange.description: A change linked to a problem (via change_relations, related_type=problem).

ProblemLinkedTicket.description: An incident (ticket) linked to a problem.

ProblemNote.description: An append-only journal entry on a problem.

email.description: Null when the requester has no mailbox — staff who sign in through a directory are often never given one. Use `username` or `display_name` to identify them.

username.description: Directory sign-in name. Null for locally registered requesters.

tenant_id.description: Company this requester belongs to. null = not known; tickets they raise in the self-service portal go to triage.

is_active.description: false = marked as left: kept on record, cannot sign in to the portal (3.5.0).

RequesterDetail.description: GET /users/{id} — Requester plus ticket counts scoped to the key's companies.

tenant_id.description: Company this requester belongs to. null = not known; tickets they raise in the self-service portal go to triage.

is_active.description: false = marked as left: kept on record, cannot sign in to the portal (3.5.0).

SlaPriorityRef.description: Raw ticket_priorities row (not passed through an API serializer).

SlaWindow.description: Response or resolution SLA computation for one clock; null if the priority has no target for that clock.

SoftwareApp.description: An inventory application (list row) with compliance-relevant counts.

install_count.description: Distinct machines with this app installed.

installs.description: Distinct non-system-component hosts with this app installed.

licensed_seats.description: Sum of quantity across Active licences.

unmetered_licences.description: true if an Active licence exists with no seat count (e.g. a site licence).

seats_available.description: licensed_seats - installs; null when unmetered_licences is true.

SoftwareAppComplianceLicence.description: A licence row summarised inside an app detail response.

quantity.description: Seat count; null for unmetered (e.g. site) licences.

app_installs.description: Distinct non-system-component machines running the app.

renewal_status.description: Computed from renewal_date vs today and notice_period_days; null if no renewal_date.

notice_period_days.description: Defaults to 30 (applied at read time) when null.

SoftwareLicenceApp.description: The application a licence belongs to.

SoftwareMachine.description: A machine an application is installed on.

StatusImpactLevel.description: A reference impact level; severity_order drives worst-impact ordering (1 = worst).

StatusIncidentService.description: One affected service on an incident, with its impact level.

StatusLookupItem.description: A closeable, coloured status lookup, shared by change statuses and problem statuses. Change statuses also carry their stage (#180).

stage.description: Change statuses only: draft, awaiting, approved, implementing, done or stopped; null = not yet classified.

StatusRef.description: An id/name status reference with its closed flag. Null when unset. A change status also carries its stage (#180).

stage.description: Change statuses only: draft, awaiting, approved, implementing, done or stopped; null = not yet classified.

StatusServiceCurrentStatus.description: Derived worst-open-impact status (the default impact level — Operational unless renamed — when no open incident affects the service).

open_incidents.description: Open incidents currently touching this service.

Task.description: A task as returned by list/create/update/move.

estimate_hours.description: How long the task should take, in hours (3.3.0).

subtasks.description: Done/total counts of this task's direct subtasks.

TaskCommentCreateAck.description: Response to posting a new comment — comments have no edit/delete in the product, so this is not the full TaskComment shape.

TaskDeleteAck.description: Acknowledgement for a hard delete — subtasks, comments and tag links are removed with it.

subtasks_deleted.description: Count of descendant subtasks deleted along with this task.

TaskDetail.description: The full single-task view: everything in Task plus parent/subtask/comment/link detail.

linked_ticket.description: Only populated when the API key's company scope could read this ticket directly.

snoozed_until.description: When a snoozed ticket returns to the working queue. Null when the ticket is not asleep. Read-only: snooze from the inbox.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields (Tickets -> Settings -> Custom fields), keyed by field key: every field this ticket has, null when unanswered. Returned by GET /tickets/{id}, POST and PATCH. Send the same object on POST or PATCH to set them; "" clears one.

TicketDetail.description: GET /tickets/{id} — full Ticket plus the original request body.

TicketNoteCreated.description: POST /tickets/{id}/notes response — a narrower shape than TicketNote (no analyst/created_at).

ticket_id.description: Echoes the {id} path segment verbatim (not cast to int).

TicketPriority.description: A ticket priority with its SLA targets (GET /priorities).

TicketSla.description: Live, compute-on-read SLA state for a ticket (same engine the UI uses).

reason_disabled.description: Why SLA is not enforced/computed for this ticket; informational only when enabled=false.

TimeEntryCreated.description: POST /tickets/{id}/time-entries response — a narrower shape than TimeEntry (no notes/analyst).

ticket_id.description: Echoes the {id} path segment verbatim (not cast to int).

Workflow.description: A workflow with its full rule body — used by get/create/update.

company.description: The company this workflow runs for. Null = shared: it runs for every company (and on a single-company install, always).

type.description: Input type, e.g. text, select, lookup.

default.description: The arg's default value; shape depends on its type, or null if none.

supports_vars.description: Whether {{template}} variables may be used in this arg.

lookup.description: Reference-data source to populate this arg from (e.g. "statuses"), if applicable.

WorkflowActionStep.description: One action step. type must be one of the engine's known action types (see GET /workflow-actions); args is a free-form map of that action's named arguments, values may contain {{template.vars}}.

args.description: Action-specific named arguments (dynamic — see GET /workflow-actions for the shape per action type).

WorkflowCondition.description: One condition clause. field is a dotted path into the trigger payload (see GET /workflow-triggers); op must be one of the engine's known operators for that field's type; value shape depends on the operator (e.g. a single value, or an array for "in").

WorkflowExecution.description: Full execution detail, including the trigger payload snapshot and per-step log — used by GET /workflow-executions/{id}.

company.description: The company the triggering event belonged to. Null = none known (a settings event, or a run from before companies were recorded on runs).

status.description: One of: running, success, failed, skipped, aborted.

WorkflowExecutionSummary.description: An execution without its payload/step-log detail — used by the list endpoints.

id.description: Null when the parent workflow has been deleted (see name for the attribution snapshot).

company.description: The company the triggering event belonged to. Null = none known (a settings event, or a run from before companies were recorded on runs).

status.description: One of: running, success, failed, skipped, aborted.

WorkflowFireResult.description: The manual test-fire result — a real execution that does NOT bump the workflow's run_count / last_run.

status.description: One of: success, failed, skipped, aborted.

step_log.description: Per-step results (dynamic shape per action type).

WorkflowLastRun.description: Null until the workflow has run at least once (manual test-fires do not update this).

status.description: One of: success, failed, skipped, aborted.

WorkflowSummary.description: A workflow without its rule body — used by GET /workflows (the landing-page list).

company.description: The company this workflow runs for. Null = shared: it runs for every company (and on a single-company install, always).

type.description: The field's data type (e.g. string, number, boolean, select, date).

operators.description: The comparison operators valid for this field type.

Project.description: A project (3.2.0). health is worked out, not stored - the health the portfolio shows.

code.description: The reference people say out loud, e.g. PRJ-0042.

health.description: null for a closed or cancelled project.

health_mode.description: auto = worked out; manual = set by hand.

priority.description: How much the project matters next to the others (3.3.0). The words shown for each are a setting.

visibility.description: Who can see it (3.3.0): everyone with Projects, or its team and people who manage Projects. A members-only project the key's analyst may not see is not found.

approval.description: 3.3.0. Where a proposal's approval stands; null when the project needed none.

tools.description: The tools switched on: people, scope, raci, raid, gates, budget.

exceptions.description: Tolerances exceeded now. kind: time, stage_time, risk or cost.

budget.description: Totals in the project's currency; see GET /projects/{id}/budget for the detail.

forecast.description: 3.3.0. What it is now expected to cost.

id.description: The project id from the path.

tasks_detached.description: Its tasks are kept, taken out of the project.

next_stage.description: The stage this decision started, if any.

escalation.description: Set while the entry is escalated (3.3.0).

actual.description: What counts: the amount entered, else the contract's value in the same currency.

currency_mismatch.description: true = its contract is in another currency: shown, not counted.

planned_date.description: 3.3.0. When the money is expected to go out.

forecast.description: 3.3.0. What the line is now expected to cost: forecast_entered, otherwise the larger of planned and actual. null when it has neither.

forecast_entered.description: 3.3.0. The forecast somebody typed, or null.

ProjectBudget.description: In the project's currency. Amounts in different currencies are never added.

forecast.description: 3.3.0. What the project is now expected to cost (estimate at completion).

cost.description: null when labour is shown in hours.

to_come_hours.description: 3.3.0. Hours left on open tasks' estimates.

to_come_cost.description: 3.3.0. Those hours priced at today's rate; null in hours mode, with no rate, or when estimates are left out of the forecast.

ProjectLinks.description: By kind - asset, change, ticket, contract, cmdb, article, problem - only those the key's analyst may open.

CostCentre.description: A cost centre (GH #160). Always one company's. The code is text, returned exactly as stored - "0010" stays "0010".

is_active.description: false = not offered for new assignments; kept on anything already charged to it.

CostCentreSyncResult.description: What a sync did (or, with dry_run, would do).

line.description: 1-based position in cost_centres; null for one made inactive because it was missing from the list.
